name: SysEx Test
author: Schwung
description: Sends and validates large SysEx over cable 2, and drives an OXI E16 in remote mode. Pads 1-4 pick a payload size; the tool packetizes, sends in one burst, and reports how many packets the host refused. Pad 5 sends arbitrary hex from a file. Pads 6-9 are the E16: enter and exit remote mode, push OLED labels, and push LED rings. Inbound SysEx is reassembled and checked byte-for-byte against the same generator, and the last channel-voice message from the device is shown, so a turn or button press confirms remote mode even when the ACK does not arrive.
